1.explanation: 1. CodeSnippet.js is the core component; it does not accept or handle a wrapText prop and always renders <pre> with default white-space, so text never wraps. 2. CodeSnippet-story.js needs to be updated to include the new wrapText knob/prop so developers can preview and document wrapping. 3. CodeSnippet-test.js should be extended to include unit tests verifying that when wrapText is true, appropriate classNames or inline styles are applied to cause <pre> to use white-space: pre-wrap, enabling text wrapping.
1.bug_scenario: When using the React <CodeSnippet type="multi" wrapText> in a narrow container, long single-line strings (like a long CRN) never break to a new line; instead a horizontal scroll bar appears (see screenshot). The user requested a wrapText prop to enable word wrapping so that long lines wrap to multiple lines instead of scrolling.
